notes: Standard first-party global Claude API rates.
The 5-minute cache-write rate is the default for cache-creation tokens whose TTL breakdown is unavailable.
Standard paid-tier Gemini Developer API promotional rates in effect through 2026-12-31.
Explicit-cache storage, grounding, and other tool charges are excluded because Harbor token telemetry does not expose them.
Cache writes are billed at 1.25 times the uncached-input rate.
The long-context multiplier is applied per API call when per-call telemetry is available.
Automatic cache misses are billed as uncached input; cache hits use the cached-input rate.
The Qwen Code native pairing is currently offered through an Alibaba Cloud Model Studio Token Plan.

No frozen first-party per-token Qwen 3.8 Max USD rate was available on the retrieval date, so normalized API-equivalent cost is intentionally unavailable rather than inferred from another Qwen version or from a variable credit conversion.

excluded: batch, flex, priority, fast-mode, data-residency, and negotiated-price modifiers
normalization_scope.method: Direct-provider standard API-equivalent token cost. Input totals include cached and cache-creation tokens; output totals include reasoning/thinking tokens when the adapter reports them.
